description: Adds and/or removes the same categories on many showcase items (photos or videos) at once. Use it to put uploaded items into filter tabs, with itemIds from upload_photos / upload_videos (files[].id; library video ids work too) or list_showcase_items. Up to 1000 items per call; category names that don't exist yet are created. For per-item changes or alt text, use update_items.

addCategoryIds.description: Existing category ids to add, e.g. ["0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"].

addCategoryNames.description: Category names to add, created if missing, e.g. ["Decks", "Patios"].

itemIds.description: Item ids (files[].id from uploads, or from list_showcase_items), e.g. ["0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"].

name: tag_items
title: Tag showcase items
